messages:
maria: Heads-up — we need public IP & ENI headroom in eu-north-1 and me-south-1 for the new dedicated GPU pool (Q2 launch). Planning across 3 AWS accounts: infra-prod, infra-staging, infra-dev. TL;DR: request EIPs, ENIs, VPC IPv6 assignment and increase max VPCs per region. Details below.

ark: numbers?

maria: Rough ask per account: eu-north-1 -> +250 Elastic IPs, +300 ENIs, one IPv6 /56 to attach to VPCs (for pod IPv6); allow 30 VPCs. me-south-1 -> +120 EIPs, +140 ENIs, /56 IPv6, allow 12 VPCs. Total across org: EIPs 1,110 across 3 accounts (we'll split), ENIs 1,320. These support ~220 new GPU instances (each uses one ENI; we allow burst and per-pod secondary IPs).

jackie: Quick q — why EIPs per node? can't we use NAT Gateway + private subnets to reduce EIP count?

maria: Good q. For Dedicated pools we need controllable public egress for debug/benchmarks and some customer workloads require static IPs for allowlists. Also for spot repro we attach secondary ENI for debug routing. NAT is an option but increases per-request latency and NAT GW cost at our scale; EIPs preferred where static egress matters.

samir: Any chance to use prefix delegation or IPv6-only for new pools to avoid EIP explosion?

maria: We're requesting IPv6 /56 per account to dual-stack pods. That reduces ephemeral EIP needs, but customers still need IPv4 for some 3rd-party integrations. So IPv6 is complementary.

ark: I'll open AWS support cases. Would like exact account IDs and split by account. maria can you paste account IDs + contact + justification text we can attach?

maria: Sure — here are account IDs and one-line justifications:

infra-prod: 111222333444 — Prod GPU Dedicated (SLAs), 250 EIPs, 300 ENIs, /56 IPv6, 30 VPCs.
infra-staging: 111222333445 — Staging & Canary, 150 EIPs, 200 ENIs, /56 IPv6, 20 VPCs.
infra-dev: 111222333446 — Dev/test for bootstrapping, 100 EIPs, 120 ENIs, /56 IPv6, 12 VPCs.

Total ask rationale: steady ramp to 220+ GPU nodes with burst headroom for canaries and cross-account failover; required for customer-facing static IP allowlist and low-latency debug access.

quota-bot: Case opened: AWS-987654321 — Support level 1. ETA initial response 48hrs. Attach docs: capacity plan (s3://redwood-infra/capacity/gpu-network-plan.pdf), network architecture diagram.

jackie: Cost impact? Any estimate on EIP allocation charges + potential NAT fallback cost?

maria: Minimal monthly EIP allocation fees if unused; better than 100s of NAT GW hrs at scale. Ballpark: EIP allocation fees ~ $0.005/hr * requested EIPs (monthly ~ $400-800 for each account tier). NAT GW could be several k/mo at our throughput. We'll produce numbers in the attached sheet.

samir: One operational ask — please include tag policy (env:prod/staging/dev + purpose) so we can track and release unused EIPs quarterly.

maria: Yup — will add tagging + lifecycle purge plan to the support case. Also request AWS to increase per-AZ ENI limits to avoid instance launch failures.

ark: I'll submit the cases today for all three accounts, reference AWS-987654321, cc eng-infra. Will post case numbers here when created.

maria: Thanks — ping me if they push back, esp on IPv6 per-VPC size. We may iterate on /56 sizing or ask for per-account adjustment. :thumbsup:
